title: Welcome Biyou Technology (必优科技) as a Unique Partner
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Unique Partner · May 9, 2024

Unique Partner Network (UPN) introduction:

About Biyou Technology

Zhuhai Biyou Technology, founded 2020 — early China AIGC content-gen company. Team incubated Kingsoft Office intelligent docs (WPS AI / formerly Modou AI); 11 years Office product R&D; 3 successful AI incubations (1 acquired + 2 independent commercializations).

2021 angel from Kingsoft Office (STAR 688111); 2023 Baidu pre-A. Joint “AI Shared Lab” with Xidian University. 20+ honors: Zhuhai/Guangdong HR innovation awards; Black Horse AI innovation runner-up; Ernie Cup 3rd; iFLYTEK 2023 innovation gold; NVIDIA 2023 innovative enterprise; Jiazi Guangnian 2023 AIGC commercial-potential Top 20, etc.

Product — ChatPPT

Live AI office apps centered on ChatPPT (chat-ppt.com): generate / beautify / co-write / speech notes / animation / export — 1,000+ features; natural-language iterative edit. Also document-related foundation tech and fine-tune/training services. C-end office/workers + B enterprise edition/API.

Cases

  • Baidu Ernie Bot plugin ecosystem
  • Baidu Search — real-time render layer services
  • Smart hardware — PPT capability add-on
  • China Merchants Bank — custom enterprise UI (future KB/images)

Partner imagery — attach on ingest (12 images). Note: CN body short (~600 CJK); EN expanded within stated facts only.

— END —
